column3: The Hebrew reads “bring me into judgment”; NASB has “him.” “Indeed? on this” is rendered “also … on him.”
“Takes pleasure in” is rendered “fulfills”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Until heaven is not” is rendered “Until the heavens be no more.”
NASB uses an older verb form here. “Who will give” is rendered “Oh that”; NASB supplies “to You.”
“Service” is rendered “struggle,” and “relief” as “change.” NASB supplies “again.”
The verse is rendered loosely; “his flesh on him is in pain” is rendered “his body pains him.”
